primary_math: The original gray cells are (0,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1). Propagating a perpendicular unit face frame around every shared edge gives the exact normals in folding_audit.json. Positions1 and3 duplicate an existing face normal, so overlap, while2 has an inconsistent four-face vertex cycle. Positions4,5,6,7,8,9 give five distinct signed coordinate normals and form five faces of the cube, no face overlap; connected shared-edge hinge folds realize them. Thus exactly6 valid positions. In particular5 points to the face opposite to gray(0,0), not that same face. All source gray fills, solid polygon edges and dashed possible-position contours remain unchanged except color; no new or solidified attachment boundary is introduced.
